title: umto_barline_placement — identification mode
description: Unit 2 rhythm/meter exercise. Student sees a sequence of notes without barlines (given a time signature) and clicks between notes to place barlines where measure boundaries fall. Tests understanding of beat grouping and meter. No MIDI input. No score.umto — this type uses a flat note list rather than SATB voices.

clef.description: Staff clef for rendering. Barline placement exercises typically use treble.

time_signature.description: Time signature displayed at left of staff. Tells student how to group beats.

show_time_signature.description: Whether to render the time signature as a visual hint. May be false for advanced exercises where identifying meter is part of the task.

measures.description: Number of full measures in the exercise (excluding pickup if any).

beat_count.description: Total beats across all measures (= measures × beats_per_measure + pickup_beats).

pickup_beats.description: Number of anacrusis beats before the first full measure. 0 = no pickup.

pitch_mode.description: rhythm_only = noteheads rendered as rhythmic slashes (pitch irrelevant). pitched = full pitched noteheads.

notes.description: Ordered list of notes/rests in the exercise. Student sees these on the staff without barlines.

pitch.description: Scientific pitch string (e.g. 'B4', 'C5'). Used for rendering when pitch_mode='pitched'. May be arbitrary when pitch_mode='rhythm_only'.

duration.description: Note duration type: w=whole, h=half, q=quarter, 8=eighth, 16=sixteenth, 32=thirty-second.

dots.description: Augmentation dots. Each dot adds half the previous duration.

note_beat_onsets.description: Beat position (0-indexed) of each note in notes[]. Parallel array. Used by grader to map note positions to beat grid.

beat_positions_ticks.description: Tick positions of each beat boundary (including final barline). Length = beat_count + 1.

correct_barline_positions.description: Zero-indexed note positions after which a barline belongs. E.g. [2] means a barline appears between notes[2] and notes[3]. Student must place barlines exactly at these positions.

grading.description: Empty array for barline placement exercises (no MIDI grading).

tags.description: Skill tags embedded in data payload (also stored on Exercise.skill_tags).

x-grading-note: BarlineGrader compares student's placed barline positions (set of note indices) against correct_barline_positions. All positions must match exactly for CORRECT. No partial credit.
